page.title: Tips for creating high-quality property listings
page.body:
Tips for creating high-quality property listings


High-quality photos, detailed descriptions and features are king on PropertyList.es! The more you add, the higher your listing will rank, putting your property in front of more potential buyers and agents.

  • Description: Hook potential buyers with unique features. Paint a picture with words, target emotions (dream home!) and practicality (close to schools). The more descriptive, the better!
  • Photos: High-quality photos are key! Invest in professional shots or use a good camera with great lighting. Showcase every room and outdoor spaces. The more photos, the higher the ranking on PropertyList.es!
  • Features: Don’t skimp on the details! Highlight all the amazing features that set your property apart. Private Pool? Close to beach?  Mention them all! The more features you showcase, the more buyers you’ll attract.
  • Video: Create a video or walk-through for an immersive experience.

These are all ranking boosters!
